# The strict policy's verdict on every implementation-defined i_ file (docs/decisions/0001-vbm-json.md section 5): "<file> <accept|reject> <reason>".
# Every i_ file must have exactly one line here; the runner fails on a missing, stray or duplicate entry, and on any verdict the parsers do not give.
i_number_double_huge_neg_exp.json accept numbers are lexemes: no float range, so a huge exponent is just a lexeme
i_number_huge_exp.json accept numbers are lexemes: no float range, so a huge exponent is just a lexeme
i_number_neg_int_huge_exp.json accept numbers are lexemes: no float range, so a huge exponent is just a lexeme
i_number_pos_double_huge_exp.json accept numbers are lexemes: no float range, so a huge exponent is just a lexeme
i_number_real_neg_overflow.json accept numbers are lexemes: no float overflow
i_number_real_pos_overflow.json accept numbers are lexemes: no float overflow
i_number_real_underflow.json accept numbers are lexemes: no float underflow
i_number_too_big_neg_int.json accept numbers are lexemes: digits are unbounded, no integer range
i_number_too_big_pos_int.json accept numbers are lexemes: digits are unbounded, no integer range
i_number_very_big_negative_int.json accept numbers are lexemes: digits are unbounded, no integer range
i_object_key_lone_2nd_surrogate.json reject strict text: a lone surrogate escape is rejected, in keys too
i_string_1st_surrogate_but_2nd_missing.json reject strict text: a lone high surrogate escape
i_string_1st_valid_surrogate_2nd_invalid.json reject strict text: a high surrogate not followed by a low one
i_string_incomplete_surrogate_and_escape_valid.json reject strict text: a lone high surrogate escape
i_string_incomplete_surrogate_pair.json reject strict text: a lone high surrogate escape
i_string_incomplete_surrogates_escape_valid.json reject strict text: lone high surrogate escapes
i_string_invalid_lonely_surrogate.json reject strict text: a lone surrogate escape
i_string_invalid_surrogate.json reject strict text: a lone surrogate escape
i_string_invalid_utf-8.json reject strict text: invalid UTF-8 byte
i_string_inverted_surrogates_U+1D11E.json reject strict text: low surrogate before high, both lone
i_string_iso_latin_1.json reject strict text: a Latin-1 byte is invalid UTF-8
i_string_lone_second_surrogate.json reject strict text: a lone low surrogate escape
i_string_lone_utf8_continuation_byte.json reject strict text: a lone UTF-8 continuation byte
i_string_not_in_unicode_range.json reject strict text: a code point above U+10FFFF is invalid UTF-8
i_string_overlong_sequence_2_bytes.json reject strict text: an overlong UTF-8 encoding
i_string_overlong_sequence_6_bytes.json reject strict text: an overlong or 6-byte UTF-8 sequence
i_string_overlong_sequence_6_bytes_null.json reject strict text: an overlong or 6-byte UTF-8 sequence
i_string_truncated-utf-8.json reject strict text: a truncated UTF-8 sequence
i_string_utf16BE_no_BOM.json reject the input is UTF-16, not UTF-8 (NUL bytes outside a grammar token)
i_string_utf16LE_no_BOM.json reject the input is UTF-16, not UTF-8 (NUL bytes outside a grammar token)
i_string_UTF-16LE_with_BOM.json reject the input is UTF-16, not UTF-8 (BOM bytes are not a grammar token)
i_string_UTF-8_invalid_sequence.json reject strict text: an invalid UTF-8 sequence
i_string_UTF8_surrogate_U+D800.json reject strict text: a surrogate encoded in UTF-8 is invalid UTF-8
i_structure_500_nested_arrays.json accept nesting 500 is within maxDepth (512)
i_structure_UTF-8_BOM_empty_object.json reject a byte order mark is not whitespace in RFC 8259 and is not skipped
